description: Source code for the DataElementFile class managing memory-mapped file operations across Linux and Windows platforms, including file opening, closing, reallocation, and synchronization.

classes.name: DataElementFile
classes.description: Class handling memory-mapped file operations with platform-specific implementations for Linux and Windows.

methods.name: DataElementFile::DataElementFile
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a File object or filename, setting up memory mapping based on file size and requested type.

methods.name: DataElementFile::Load
methods.description: Loads the file and maps it into memory if not already open.

methods.name: DataElementFile::OpenMemoryMappedFile
methods.description: Platform-specific method to open and map the file into memory with the required size.

methods.name: DataElementFile::Close
methods.description: Unmaps and closes the memory-mapped file handle.

methods.name: DataElementFile::Reallocation
methods.description: Reallocates the memory-mapped file to a new size, remapping if necessary.

methods.name: DataElementFile::Sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the memory-mapped data with the underlying file.
